d: This is India Vs Pakistan World T20 match highlights in my style! This match was held at Melbourne Cricket ground and was one of the most phenomenal matches in the history of world T20! And I feel so grateful to have witnessed this one, that too in Melbourne. This was a phenomenal experience and I apologize in advance if your ears hurt after hearing me and the group scream as much! We were sitting in a corporate box for this match, and can I just say that for once I was really happy to be repping the travel influencer community in Australia.
